<error_description>
The load-bearing first sentence is false/misapplies the cited result. Guth’s Proposition 9.1 in “Area-expanding embeddings of rectangles” does exist, but in the cited case \(n=4\), \(k=2\), \(\dim X=1\), \(\dim Y=2\) it has \(j=1\) and \(l-j=2\), hence \(l=3\), and its stated conclusion is
\[
|X|^{(l-j)/(k-j)}|Y|
=
|X|^2|Y|
\ge c(4)(S_1)^{2}S_2S_3.
\]
For the present notation this would give only
\[
a^2uv\ge c\,S_1^2S_2S_3,
\]
not the asserted lower bound
\[
abuv\ge c_0\,S_1S_2^{1/2}S_3^{3/2}S_4.
\]
The cited proposition’s statement, as printed, bounds \(|X|^{(l-j)/(k-j)}|Y|\), not the full \(4\)-volume \(abuv\), and it contains neither the smallness assumptions \(a\le \varepsilon_0S_1\), \(uv\le \varepsilon_0S_3S_4\) nor the asserted conclusion. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0710.0403))

Nor is this repaired by taking \(l=4\): then the middle factor would have dimension \(l-j=3\), not \(\dim Y=2\), and Proposition 9.1 would yield \(a^3buv\ge cS_1^3S_2S_3S_4\), which after using \(a\le\varepsilon_0S_1\) gives at best a bound proportional to \(S_1S_2S_3S_4\), not the required stronger factor \(S_1S_2^{1/2}S_3^{3/2}S_4\) when \(S_3>S_2\). Thus the proposed proof cites a real result but claims it states/implies a different proposition.

The thesis citation exists as a Guth MIT thesis/reference, but the proof does not identify a theorem/proposition in the thesis whose statement is the Assertion or whose hypotheses can be audited; the vague statement that “a fuller account appears” cannot substitute for the missing implication from Proposition 9.1. The arXiv paper’s own references list “Area-contracting Maps Between Rectangles, Thesis, MIT 2005,” and independent indexing also records Guth’s dissertation title, but this does not verify the asserted proposition. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0710.0403))
